🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* US Government\/USTR
• *Announcement:* The US Senate has passed a bill that could grant President Trump power to impose up to 100\% tariffs on Indian goods due to continued Russian oil purchases, prompting Indian suppliers to plan pivoting away from the US market\.
• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* MEDIUM \(70\% \- The US Senate has passed a bill, and the news reports "100\% Tariffs Looming" and "fraught with tension", indicating a significant and probable policy shift, though not yet enacted and awaiting presidential decision\.\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* Textiles, Metals\/Auto, EMS, Chemicals, Pharma
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* None
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(Increased trade tensions and potential tariffs on key export sectors to the US create a risk\-off macro environment and strengthen USD\/INR pressure\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Fund managers should consider reducing exposure to Indian export\-oriented sectors heavily reliant on the US market, such as Textiles, Pharma, and Auto Components, given the looming tariff threat\.
